title: Can LLM Agents Learn to Test? Maintaining Scoped Experience as Testing Evidence for Mobile GUI Testing
title_zh: LLM智能体能否学会测试？以范围受限的经验维护作为移动GUI测试的测试证据

paragraphs.en: 提出AdaptiTest经验维护契约，使LLM测试器保留可复用经验并暂存过时条目，记忆显著提升移动GUI测试完成率。 Repeated mobile GUI tests can reuse routes, locators, and recovery strategies from earlier executions. However, a route that worked in one workflow or app version may be irrelevant or misleading in another. We study how an LLM-based tester can retain useful experience while withholding entries contradicted by current observations. We present a maintenance contract for AdaptiTest in which reusable experience has an explicit applicability scope, trace provenance, and a lifecycle for confirmation, revalidation, and withdrawal. The contract reserves persistence for a Reflector role and treats recalled experience as advice. The archived implementation does not establish end-to-end enforcement of every specified mechanism. The design changes retrieved context, not model weights. The evaluation uses read-only Android workflows and archived internal comparisons. A six-task, three-repeat ready subset reports 18/18 completed runs with memory versus 3/18 without it, but a grounded single-agent control also solves the earlier hard-task slice. A separate cross-session probe is excluded from efficacy conclusions because of confounded route schedules and unvalidated state labels. We examine 13 selected real-update hazard records across nine subjects, distinguishing stale-locator observations from policy-based withholding and offline retrieval diagnostics. The latter do not measure live-device failures or actions saved. These events are UI changes, not confirmed regression bugs. The evidence supports a bounded design and case study; it does not establish general efficacy, superiority over independent GUI-agent systems, or unrestricted exploration.
paragraphs.zh: 提出AdaptiTest经验维护契约，使LLM测试器保留可复用经验并暂存过时条目，记忆显著提升移动GUI测试完成率。重复的移动GUI测试可以复用先前执行中的路径、定位器和恢复策略。 然而，在某个工作流或应用版本中有效的路径，在另一个中可能不相关或具有误导性。 我们研究基于LLM的测试器如何保留有用的经验，同时暂存与当前观察相矛盾的条目。 我们为AdaptiTest提出一个维护契约，其中可复用经验具有明确的适用范围、轨迹来源，以及确认、重新验证和撤销的生命周期。 该契约将持久化保留给Reflector角色，并将召回的经验视为建议。 归档的实现并未对每个已规定的机制建立端到端的强制执行。 该设计改变的是检索到的上下文，而非模型权重。 评估使用只读的Android工作流和归档的内部对比。 一个六任务、三次重复的就绪子集报告了有记忆时18/18的完成运行率，而无记忆时仅为3/18，但一个有依据的单智能体对照也解决了此前的困难任务切片。 一项独立的跨会话探测因混淆的路径调度和未经验证的状态标签而被排除在有效性结论之外。 我们检验了跨九个受试对象选出的13条真实更新风险记录，区分过时定位器观察、基于策略的暂存以及离线检索诊断。 后者并不测量真机上的失败或已保存的动作。 这些事件是UI变化，而非已确认的回归缺陷。 这些证据支持一个有边界的设计和案例研究；它并未确立普遍有效性、相对于独立GUI智能体系统的优越性，或无限制的探索。
